summary_rationale: Billionbrains Garage Ventures (Groww) commands #1 NSE active client share (29.16%, ~1.34-1.35 Cr clients) powered by a zero-CAC direct mutual fund and IPO onboarding funnel, delivering 64.5% Q2 FY27 OPM, 37.3% ROCE, 28.8% ROE, and near-zero debt (Rs 77 Cr borrowings vs Rs 11,568 Cr equity). KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because while equity derivatives concentration fell from 56.9% to 44.8% YoY as MTF (Rs 4,351 Cr, +161% YoY), AMC (Rs 7,179 Cr), and Wealth (>Rs 10,000 Cr) scaled, 44.8% F&O exposure remains sensitive to SEBI rules (lot-size/expiry curbs, CAS) and negative FY25-FY26 CFO reflects ongoing MTF working-capital absorption.
